summary: Comprehensive Playwright UI verification of iteration 2 (Cue/Headphone pre-listen, Live hotkeys, Drag-from-OS overlay, plus full regression). All 16 test assertions pass against the deployed preview URL. Backend intentionally skipped (client-only app).

issues: Emergent instrumentation injects a <span> inside <option>, producing a benign React hydration warning in console. Not caused by app code.

verified_flows.regression_play_track_0: play-track-0 -> player-track-name='alpha.wav', ON AIR indicator, current-time advanced
verified_flows.cue_1_independence: With alpha.wav playing, cue-track-1 click -> cue-track-name='beta.wav' AND player-track-name still 'alpha.wav' (fully independent)
verified_flows.cue_2_toggle_seek_stop: cue-toggle-button pauses/resumes (title toggles), cue-seek-bar click updates cue position, cue-stop-button removes cue-track-name element and shows idle helper text
verified_flows.cue_3_visual_distinction: row0 (on-air) class contains 'border-[var(--hl-fire)]' (orange), row2 (cued) class contains 'border-[var(--hl-amber)]' (amber) — visually distinct. cue-track-<index> button present on all 3 rows
verified_flows.routing_selects: program-output-select and cue-output-select ARE rendered (headless Chromium in this harness actually exposes a default audiooutput device, so 'hasDevices' is true and both selects appear with 'Default' option). No bug.
verified_flows.hotkey_space: Focus body -> Space toggles play/pause (button title 'Play' <-> 'Pause')
verified_flows.hotkey_volume: From 0.5: ArrowUp x2 -> 0.6, ArrowDown x3 -> 0.45 (0.05 increments as coded)
verified_flows.hotkey_ignored_in_input: Focus new-playlist-input, press Space -> playback state unchanged AND space char inserted into input value ('Morning Show ')
verified_flows.drag_from_desktop_overlay: Dispatched synthetic dragenter/dragover with DataTransfer containing a File (types includes 'Files') on track-list-panel -> drop-overlay element appears with 'Drop MP3 / WAV files to add' text (visible in screenshot). Actual OS-level file drop not automatable in headless browser; import path already covered by add-files-input.

critical_code_review_comments: audioEngine cue element and main element share document body; no explicit gain routing per-stream — fine for now, but if program+cue must go to different physical devices, verify setSinkId() actually splits them (only works over HTMLMediaElement, which this uses — ok).

App.js hotkeys effect uses e.code (physical key). This is correct for Space/Arrow*/KeyC and won't trigger on typing keys, but note that international keyboards mapping physical 'C' will still trigger cue-stop; acceptable for a DJ app.

TrackList.onZoneDrop reads e.dataTransfer.files which is empty in synthetic events. Real OS drag will populate it. In non-Electron browser mode this works via addBrowserFiles; in Electron the code branches on files[0].path — good.
readDuration still resolves 0 on error -> renders '--:--'; unchanged from iter 1 — non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Generated three 2-second 22.05kHz mono WAV files at /tmp/wavs/{alpha,beta,gamma}.wav via python wave module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This is a client-only app. Preview URL comes from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Sidebar uses new-playlist-button then new-playlist-input then confirm-create-playlist (NOT a single create-playlist-button). Hotkeys use e.code and are correctly bypassed on input/select/textarea. Headless Chromium here DOES expose one default audiooutput, so program-output-select + cue-output-select are visible. For drop-overlay simulation, dispatch DragEvent with a DataTransfer that has an added File (dt.items.add(file)) so types includes 'Files'; verify overlay visibility via screenshot rather than immediate synchronous DOM query due to React state timing.
